category.quote: Each subscriber under APY shall receive a  guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1000/- per month or Rs. 2000/- per month or Rs. 3000/- per month or Rs. 4000/- per month or Rs. 5000/- per month, after the age of 60 years until death.

age.quote: The minimum age of joining APY is 18 years and maximum is 40 years.

gate_notes: Excludes any citizen who is or has been an income tax payer from joining as of 1st October 2022.
